purpose: Master animation stage graph for Profile B + per-preset stage-applicability matrix, evidence-gated to data/profile-b-evidence-package.json. A stage is only animated where the frozen package supports it; otherwise it is CONTEXTUAL, ABSTRACT_SUPPORTED, NOT_APPLICABLE, or DO_NOT_ANIMATE.

stage_status_enum.SUPPORTED: directly supported by the preset's evidence - animate (quantitatively where a value exists, else qualitatively)
stage_status_enum.ABSTRACT_SUPPORTED: supported only at abstract/mechanism level - animate qualitatively, NO numeric labels or deterministic timing
stage_status_enum.CONTEXTUAL: shown for orientation only, visibly marked 'illustrative', not a quantified process
stage_status_enum.NOT_APPLICABLE: the preset's route/system does not include this stage
stage_status_enum.DO_NOT_ANIMATE: explicitly unsupported by the package - must not appear as a real event

B1_chen2012_topical_nlc.route: topical (skin) - NOT systemic; there is NO bloodstream-circulation stage

S3_administration.scene: topical NLC dispersion applied to skin surface (rat abdominal skin context)

S4_transport.scene: permeation through skin depth layers 0-30 / 30-60 / 60-90 um (Franz-cell context)
S4_transport.note: blood-vessel extravasation and ECM traversal = DO_NOT_ANIMATE

S5_arrival.scene: reaching local melanoma tissue in skin

S6_cell_interaction.note: intact-skin-tissue cell-identity uptake = UNSUPPORTED; show only as separate cell-assay context; intracellular transport = DO_NOT_ANIMATE

S7_release.scene: delayed/sustained release from NLC (qualitative; first-order selected)
S7_release.note: show release occurring; exact per-config release-% not in package -> qualitative + info note

S8_effect.scene: reduced tumor burden in melanoma-bearing mouse

S3_administration.evidence: tumor-bearing mice; route details NOT REPORTED

S4_transport.evidence: NOT REPORTED for PK/biodistribution -> no timing, no numeric labels

S5_arrival.evidence: B16F10 in vitro; melanoma + lung-metastasis models

S7_release.evidence: release NOT REPORTED -> do not show a release curve

S8_effect.scene: ER stress -> CRT/HMGB1/ATP -> DC maturation -> CD8+ activation -> antitumor/anti-metastasis

B2_wang2025_ER_targeting.rule: abstract-supported only: NO sliders, NO numeric labels, NO deterministic timing for any physicochemical parameter

S8_effect.scene: improved intestinal permeability (info panel), 30-fold solubility, stability in PBS/plasma

B3_shukla2020_SBEbetaCD.rule: render as an INFO/COMPARATOR panel, not a body-travel animation. No precipitation/aggregation/particle-growth animation.
DO_NOT_ANIMATE: nanoparticle morphology (it is a molecular complex, not an NP)

review_identified_only.animation_policy: NOT animated. Appear only in a 'research candidates / future evidence' panel with title + DOI.

global_fidelity_rules: Every animated event carries an evidence badge (see data/profile-b-animation-info-panels.json).
When timing is unknown, show a qualitative event + an info note (e.g. 'Sustained release reported; exact kinetics not available').
Never invent a numeric value, curve, rate, or onset time.
Route determines which stages exist; B1 has no circulation stage.
Confounded relationships (e.g. surface charge vs lipid in B1) must carry the confound note.
